howto: Each level is a picture cut into squares. The faint picture on the board shows where every piece belongs.
Drag a piece from the tray onto its spot. A right piece locks in green and builds a combo.
A wrong piece sits in its cell with an orange edge until you drag it somewhere else.
Fill the board. Fewer moves earn more stars; clearing a level unlocks the next.
tips: Start with the corners and edges: they are the easiest to match to the faint picture.
Look for the sun, clouds and hill lines: they run across several pieces.
HINT lights up a piece and its spot, or points out a piece that is in the wrong cell.
UNDO takes back your last move, including a swap.
The Daily Puzzle is a new picture every day: clear it each day to grow your streak.
Leave whenever you like: the puzzle in progress is kept, and PLAY turns into CONTINUE.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys move the cursor on the board, N picks the next piece, Enter places it, H for a hint, U to undo. P pauses.
controls.touch: Drag a piece onto the board, or tap a piece and then tap a square. HINT and UNDO sit under the tray.

difficulty: Easy cuts the picture into 3x3 pieces, Normal 4x4 and Hard 5x5. Pick it on the title screen; stars are kept per difficulty.

cheats.effect: The picture on the board shows at full strength
Drop a piece anywhere on the board and it flies to its own spot
Party mode: rainbow pieces and star bursts on every snap

features.hints: HINT button (and the arcade Hint): lights up the next useful piece and its spot, or names a piece that is in the wrong cell; an idle hint appears after 20 seconds
features.undo: UNDO button (or U) takes back the last move, putting any piece it swapped out back too
features.level-select-or-daily: LEVELS screen with twelve pictures and their stars, plus a Daily Puzzle with a day streak
features.results: PUZZLE COMPLETE card with stars, moves, time, score and your best, plus Next, Play again and Levels
features.tutorial: Three-step first-run coach: the board, a guided drag of one glowing piece, then Hint and Undo; replay from How to play
